units.source_text: “一个人在一生当中，也许要做一两件可怕的坏事吧。”

en.t: Perhaps in the course of a lifetime, a person does one or two terrible things.

units.source_text: 母亲继续说，“抢走别人的婴儿，恐怕比强盗抢钱财，抢其他东西都罪孽深吧，也许比杀人还要坏！”

en.t: Mother went on, "To steal someone else's baby is probably a deeper sin than a robber stealing money or other things, and perhaps even worse than killing someone!"
